ohtani.title: Emmet Sheehan's superb outing fuels Dodgers' 6-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Teoscar Hernández belts a three-run homer and Emmet Sheehan strikes out 10 to lead the Dodgers over the Reds, 6-3

imanaga.title: Craig Counsell recaps the Cubs' win vs. Pirates
imanaga.blurb: Craig Counsell talks about the feisty Cubs offense, Alex Bregman's two-run home run, how the second half of the season is going and more

suzuki.title: Michael Busch, Pedro Ramírez power Cubs to 4-3 win
suzuki.blurb: Michael Busch and Pedro Ramírez slug home runs to power the Cubs' 4-3 win over the Pirates

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Alejandro Kirk homers in Blue Jays’ 7-3 win
okamoto.blurb: Alejandro Kirk homers and drives in three and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. drives in a run in the Blue Jays’ 7-3 win over the Orioles

murakami.title: Randal Grichuk, Tristan Peters fuel White Sox 6-5 win
murakami.blurb: Randal Grichuk delivers the go-ahead knock and the White Sox score three runs in the 5th to give them a 6-5 win over the Cardinals\n

matsui.title: Merrill, five-run 3rd inning lead Padres to win
matsui.blurb: Jackson Merrill tallies three hits and the Padres' rally for five runs in the 3rd inning in their 7-5 win over the Giants
